headline: Kereta Api Siantar Ekspres Collides With Minibus In Simalungun
seoTitle: Kereta Api Siantar Ekspres Collision In Simalungun
metaDescription: A collision between Kereta Api Siantar Ekspres and a minibus in Simalungun resulted in one fatality and injured three railway staff members.
aiSummaryBullets: A fatal collision occurred between the Kereta Api Siantar Ekspres and a minibus in Simalungun, North Sumatra, on November 20, 2026.
The minibus driver died in the incident, while three railway staff members sustained injuries.
The train locomotive caught fire following the collision, though all 264 passengers on board were reported safe.
aiContextParagraph: On November 20, 2026, a passenger train operating as the Kereta Api Siantar Ekspres collided with a public minibus on a railway crossing in Simalungun Regency, North Sumatra. The accident occurred between Siantar Station and Dolok Merangir Station at kilometer 387/6. Following the impact, the train's locomotive caught fire, leading to viral social media footage of the burning carriage. Authorities confirmed that the driver of the minibus died at the scene, with his body initially trapped within the wreckage. Additionally, three railway employees sustained injuries due to the collision and subsequent fire. PT Kereta Api Indonesia confirmed the incident, noting that while the locomotive was severely damaged, all 264 passengers traveling on the Siantar-Medan route were evacuated safely. Emergency teams responded to the site, where the train remained temporarily incapacitated after the incident.
whyItIsViral: The incident received significant attention due to coverage by multiple news outlets and strong public search interest regarding the train route.
